title: Event data in a workflow expression via run: echo "${{ github.event.issue.title }}" (github-actions) — review required
description: The github-actions expression run: echo "${{ github.event.issue.title }}" splices event fields into the workflow. Event fields are attacker-controlled text (issue titles, PR bodies, branch names), and an interpolated field is evaluated as part of the shell or action input, so a crafted title can inject commands. Pass the value through an environment variable instead (env: TITLE: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}). This lexical rule flags the expression.
remediation: Pass event data through env: and reference the variable in the script (env: TITLE: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}); never interpolate event fields directly.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the expression wherever it appears, including non-shell inputs such as env: values, which are the safe pattern.
